items.distractor_fact: Anno autem superiore, eodem die, tabulae publicae temperaturam {D}°C rettulerunt.
items.gloss_en: But last year, on the same day, public records reported a temperature of {D}°C.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: an archival public record from a previous year (a series), not the first distractor's neighboring-village weather station (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Pretium autem auri eodem die ${D} fuit.
items.gloss_en: But the price of gold was $D that same day.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a commodity (gold), not the first distractor's owner, another company's share (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Altitudo autem aquae in cisterna aquaeductus urbani eodem tempore {D}m fuit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the water level in the municipal aqueduct's cistern was {D}m at that same time.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a municipal utility's cistern (an organisation), not the first distractor's nearby river (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Turris autem moderatrix aeroportus vicini eodem tempore altitudinem {D}m aeronavis commercialis notavit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the control tower of a nearby airport recorded a commercial aircraft's altitude of {D}m at the same time.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a place/organisation (an airport tower observing an unrelated aircraft), not the first distractor's owner, another drone flying simultaneously (an entity)

items.distractor_fact: Vas autem mercium in officina vectigali pondere {D}kg deprehensum est.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile a container of goods found at the customs office weighed {D}kg.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a container held at a customs office (a place), not the first distractor's owner, another package shipped the same day (an entity); avoids reusing the noun 'sarcina'

items.distractor_fact: Celeritas autem summa cuiusdam certaminis anno superiore acta {D}km/h fuit.
items.gloss_en: But the top speed achieved in a certain race last year was {D}km/h.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a record from a past year's race (a series), not the first distractor's owner, an engine fitted in a different vehicle (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Institutum autem summum punctorum, anno praeterito in hoc ludo actum, {D}pts fuit.
items.gloss_en: But the high score set in this game last year was {D}pts.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a record from last year's play of the game (a series), not the first distractor's owner, another player competing in the same game (a person)

items.distractor_fact: Unus autem lusor, apud gregem alium per idem tempus ludens, puncta {D} per totum tempus sibi accepit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile one player, playing for a different team over the same period, scored {D} goals for himself over the season.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a single player (a person), not the first distractor's owner, a different team in a separate competition (an entity)

items.distractor_fact: In tabula autem stationis proximae, adventus currus cuiusdam alterius {D}min post mediam noctem monstratus est, cuius tempus secundum tabulam ibidem non indicatur.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile, on the display board of the nearby station, the arrival of some other train was shown as {D} minutes after midnight, whose own scheduled time is not given there.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner: a station's arrival display (a place) showing an unrelated train whose own schedule is not stated, not the first distractor's owner, another train on a different line (an entity); satisfies the shared-reference rule since no schedule is given for it
